author: dmaretskyi
principle: Expose reactive state as a single stream that emits its current value immediately, instead of separate one-shot getters and subscribe methods; a caller wanting only the current value can take the first emission.
fix_shape: collapse the getter + subscribe pair into one Stream<Option<...>> API.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Use the established Stream-to-Atom-to-useAtom bridge for reactive hooks instead of writing a custom subscription hook.
fix_shape: replace the custom hook with the standard Stream->Atom->useAtom pattern.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Keep a React context limited to providing services; let hooks use the default reactive runtime rather than threading a custom runtime through the service context.
fix_shape: remove the custom runtime from the context and use the default atom runtime in the hooks.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Reference an existing record in its registry rather than duplicating or copying its data elsewhere.
fix_shape: look the record up from the registry instead of storing a separate copy.

fix_shape: look the record up from the registry instead of storing a separate copy.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Prefer an existing lighter-weight mechanism over introducing a heavier one when the lighter mechanism already covers the need.
fix_shape: use the existing trigger mechanism instead of adding a new routine concept.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: For an immutable/versioned view of an object, expose a pure function that returns a new snapshot instance rather than mutating state on the existing object to switch its version.
fix_shape: add a `getVersion(obj, version) -> Snapshot` function instead of pinning version state onto the live object.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: For an immutable/versioned view of an object, expose a pure function that returns a new snapshot instance rather than mutating state on the existing object to switch its version.
fix_shape: add a `getVersion(obj, version) -> Snapshot` function instead of pinning version state onto the live object.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Represent a per-object concept as an accessor/property on the object itself rather than introducing a separate parallel API surface for it.
fix_shape: add the concept as an accessor (e.g. Obj.getBranch(obj)) instead of a standalone parallel API.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Prefer accepting the richer, strongly-typed value (the object itself) over a raw identifier when a function needs to operate on that object, and put the operation as a method/accessor on the owning module.
fix_shape: change the parameter from a raw id to the object, and move the function onto the owning module as an accessor.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: An API must commit to one mutation model — returning an independent copy vs. mutating a shared instance in place — rather than implying both at once.
fix_shape: pick one branching model (copy-on-branch or checkout-in-place) and redesign the API around it consistently.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Store only the combined/final state plus minimal version bookkeeping, rather than appending every intermediate update, when only the latest state is ever needed.
fix_shape: replace the append-only update log with a single current-state field plus version markers.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Extract logic that doesn't belong to a function's core responsibility into a separate function rather than inlining it.
fix_shape: pull the unrelated logic out into its own function.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Keep a lightweight, frequently-touched record free of unbounded per-update bookkeeping; put that functionality in the specialized mechanism designed for it instead of overloading the light record.
fix_shape: remove the per-update tracking from the light record and reserve it for the dedicated subscription mechanism.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Restrict who is allowed to publish to a shared broadcast channel to the single intended producer, not every participant.
fix_shape: gate the publish path so only the designated producer (e.g. edge) writes to the shared channel.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Use existing branded types for domain values instead of raw primitives where a branded type already exists.
fix_shape: replace the raw string/number fields with the existing branded types.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Don't add a new convenience helper that duplicates what's already expressible by composing existing primitives; use the existing composable API instead of introducing a parallel one.
fix_shape: delete the new helper and call the existing composable function directly.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: An algorithm that will run at scale must not have complexity proportional to the total number of items ever processed; use a bounded approach and document where an unbounded approach is acceptable only locally.
fix_shape: replace the growing-with-history approach with a bounded one for the at-scale deployment, noting the local exception in a comment.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Fix a deficiency at its source, the layer that owns the behavior, rather than adding a workaround downstream for a symptom of it.
fix_shape: address the gap in the owning layer (e.g. the query/index layer) instead of special-casing it downstream.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Keep core/shared machinery unchanged and put presentation-only logic in the UI layer instead of the shared backend.
fix_shape: move the detection logic into the UI rather than changing the shared machinery.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Prefer omitting/removing a condition entirely over adding a new special-case flag to suppress it, when the simpler removal achieves the same effect.
fix_shape: remove the condition instead of introducing a new opt-out flag.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Use a typed helper that statically enforces a definition and its implementation match, rather than pairing them manually where a mismatch would only surface at runtime.
fix_shape: use the typed lazy-handler helper instead of manually wiring the definition to its implementation.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Keep configuration consistent across runtime targets rather than letting them diverge on which packages take a special path.
fix_shape: remove the special-case condition for all targets uniformly instead of a per-package flag.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Include a structured error code on an event and match against that code, rather than matching on a free-form message or other looser signal.
fix_shape: add an error-code field to the event and switch the matching logic to compare against it.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Don't add defensive handling for a state the system's own invariants already make impossible; rely on the invariant instead.
fix_shape: remove the defensive branch and assert the invariant instead.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Attach a function that operates on a component's state as a method on that component's owning class rather than leaving it as a free-standing function.
fix_shape: move the function onto the owning class as a method.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Prefer implementing behavior as a method on the owning class rather than as a free-standing function, when the behavior operates on that class's state.
fix_shape: convert the free function into a method on the owning class.

author: wittjosiah
principle: Don't ship a fix that only papers over a symptom without a known root cause; add diagnostics to capture the root cause when it isn't yet understood, rather than guessing at a fix.
fix_shape: add instrumentation/diagnostics to capture the root cause instead of patching the symptom.

author: wittjosiah
principle: Don't define a type in a higher layer (e.g. a plugin) that mirrors a shape already owned by a lower layer (e.g. the client); import and reuse the canonical type instead.
fix_shape: remove the plugin-local type and import the canonical client type.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Namespace an internal brand/annotation identifier string with the owning package's path to avoid collisions with similar keys elsewhere.
fix_shape: prefix the identifier string with the owning package path (e.g. `~@dxos/schema/annotation/X`).
